content.value: The induced emf in a DC machine while running at 750 rpm is 220V. (i) Calculate the speed at which the induced emf will be 240V. Assume constant flux. (ii) Also find the percentage increase in the field flux for an induced emf of 240V and speed of 700 rpm.
